verdict.rationale: Hatchet is an orchestration platform with an API, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question. The evidence shows none: probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file is LLM-oriented documentation, not an API spec, and the SDKs and CLI are adjacent features that do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
